ad cujus adventum mactavit Achab arietes
he descended to him in Samaria.
Ahab slaughtered very many sheep and oxen,
et populo qui venerat cum eo:
for him and for the people who had arrived with him.

Dixitque Achab rex Israël ad Josaphat regem Juda:
And Ahab, the king of Israel, said to Jehoshaphat,
the king of Judah, “Come with me to Ramoth Gilead.”

Numquid non est hic prophetes Domini,
“Is there not a prophet of the Lord here,

Et ait rex Israël ad Josaphat:
And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat:
Est vir unus a quo possumus quærere Domini voluntatem:
“There is one man, from whom we would be able to ask the will of the Lord.
for he never prophesies good to me,
but at all times evil. And it is Micaiah,
the son of Imlah.” And Jehoshaphat said,
“You should not speak in this manner,
Vocavit ergo rex Israël unum de eunuchis,
Therefore, the king of Israel called one of the eunuchs,
“Quickly, summon Micaiah, the son of Imlah.”
and Jehoshaphat, the king of Judah,
were both sitting upon their thrones,
sedebant autem in area juxta portam Samariæ,
And they were sitting in an open area, beside the gate of Samaria.
And all the prophets were prophesying before them.
Sedecias vero filius Chanaana fecit sibi cornua ferrea, et ait: Hæc dicit Dominus: His ventilabis Syriam, donec conteras eam.
Truly, Zedekiah, the son of Chenaanah, made for himself horns of iron, and he said: “Thus says the Lord: With these, you shall threaten Syria, until you crush it.”
And all the prophets prophesied similarly,
et tradet eos Dominus in manu regis.
and the Lord will deliver them into the hand of the king.”
Nuntius autem qui ierat ad vocandum Michæam, ait illi:
Then the messenger who had gone to summon Micaiah said to him: “Lo,
En verba omnium prophetarum uno ore bona regi annuntiant:
the words of all the prophets, with one mouth, announce good to the king.
quæso ergo te ut et sermo tuus ab eis non dissentiat,
Therefore, I ask you that you not dissent from them in your word,
quia quodcumque dixerit mihi Deus meus,
whatever my God will say to me,
Therefore, he went to the king.
And the king said to him,
ire debemus in Ramoth Galaad ad bellandum,

“Ascend. For everything will come to prosperity,
et tradentur hostes in manus vestras.
and the enemies will be delivered into your hands.”
I bind you by an oath,
nisi quod verum est in nomine Domini.
so that you will not speak to me except what is true in the name of the Lord!”
Vidi universum Israël dispersum in montibus,
“I saw all of Israel scattered amid the mountains,
revertatur unusquisque in domum suam in pace.
Let each one return in peace to his own house.’”
Et ait rex Israël ad Josaphat:
And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat:
Nonne dixi tibi quod non prophetaret iste mihi quidquam boni,
“Did I not tell you that this one would not prophesy to me anything good,
listen to the word of the Lord.
I saw the Lord sitting upon his throne,
vidi Dominum sedentem in solio suo,
and the entire army of heaven was standing beside him,
et omnem exercitum cæli assistentem ei a dextris et a sinistris.
on the right and on the left.
Quis decipiet Achab regem Israël ut ascendat et corruat in Ramoth Galaad?
‘Who will deceive Ahab, the king of Israel, so that he may ascend and fall at Ramoth Gilead?’
Cumque diceret unus hoc modo, et alter alio,
And when one spoke in one way, and another in another way,
et stetit coram Domino, et ait:
and he stood before the Lord and said,
‘I will deceive him.’ And the Lord said to him,
‘In what way will you deceive him?’
et ero spiritus mendax in ore omnium prophetarum ejus.
and I will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets.’
ecce Dominus dedit spiritum mendacii in ore omnium prophetarum tuorum,

and the Lord has spoken evil about you.”
Then Zedekiah, the son of Chenaanah, approached,
et percussit Michææ maxillam, et ait:
and he struck Micaiah on the jaw, and he said:
Per quam viam transivit spiritus Domini a me,
“In what way did the Spirit of the Lord depart from me,
so that he would speak to you?”
Tu ipse videbis in die illo,
“You yourself shall see it, in that day,
quando ingressus fueris cubiculum de cubiculo ut abscondaris.
when you will enter a room within a room, so that you may be hidden.”

et ducite eum ad Amon principem civitatis,

the Lord has not spoken by me.” And he said,
Igitur ascenderunt rex Israël et Josaphat rex Juda in Ramoth Galaad.

Rex autem Syriæ præceperat ducibus equitatus sui,
Now the king of Syria had instructed the commanders of his horsemen,
Ne pugnetis contra minimum aut contra maximum,
“You shall not fight against the least or the greatest,
but only against the king of Israel.”
Itaque cum vidissent principes equitatus Josaphat,
And so, when the leaders of the horsemen had seen Jehoshaphat,
“This one is the king of Israel.”
And while fighting, they surrounded him.
But he cried out to the Lord,
and he turned them away from him.
Cum enim vidissent duces equitatus quod non esset rex Israël,
For when the commanders of the horsemen had seen that he was not the king of Israel,
Accidit autem ut unus e populo sagittam in incertum jaceret,
Then it happened that one of the people shot an arrow indiscriminately,
et percuteret regem Israël inter cervicem et scapulas.
and it struck the king of Israel between the neck and the shoulder.
And so he said to his chariot driver:
and lead me away from the battle line.
Et finita est pugna in die illo:
And the fight ended on that day.
porro rex Israël stabat in curru suo contra Syros usque ad vesperam,
But the king of Israel was standing in his chariot facing the Syrians, even until evening.
